_owner: Cold email specialist thread. Edit wording here; the engine only fills {variables} with checked facts.
_rules: Every {variable} comes from the lead row or our own site check. A variant is used only when all its 'requires' facts exist. Lines over 240 characters are rejected. A niche without a segment here doesn't get emailed in that segment (those shops go to the call list).
